gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-montserrat-unde: Round, hollow-centered sans letters with an oversized lowercase make Montserrat Underline easy to settle into. Delius Unicase heads things with a loose, handwritten ease, and over a long stretch the body keeps its steady rhythm without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-mozilla-headlin: Mozilla Headline fills its lines with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, friendly and current in feel. Delius Unicase glides above it, handwritten and unvarying, so the two feel casual together.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-mozilla-text: Delius Unicase draws like a sign-painter's brush, one constant width from start to finish, with a relaxed, inviting manner. Mozilla Text follows with tall, flared lowercase that reads sturdy and businesslike line after line.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-nata-sans: Strokes that never taper, plus a tall x-height and rope-ladder spacing, give Delius Unicase its relaxed handwritten charm. Nata Sans answers with a plain sans steadiness, open-mouthed curves drawn as if with a technical pen.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-nobile: Nobile reads crisp and contemporary, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase and its letter mouths left open. And Delius Unicase earns its place big and brief, where its line of unchanging width can show off.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-nokora: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase writes in ribbon-like strokes that hold one width throughout. Nokora backs it with sturdy sans-serif lowercase and a generous s, so enlarging the body would crowd that handwriting quickly.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text feels literary and dignified, with generous entrances into its curves and lowercase filling most of the letter height. Delius Unicase is the better storyteller in a single thread of handwriting, while Noticia Text is the serif that carries the weight of the reading.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-kufi-arabi: Noto Kufi Arabic keeps its capitals only slightly above lowercase, with a welcoming gap in the c, so it looks modern and tidy. Delius Unicase adds a relaxed handwritten, quill-free line above.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills its line with tall, full lowercase. Over many paragraphs that plain sans feels open and unhurried, while Delius Unicase above it draws everything with a ruler-straight, constant-width line.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets c, s and z stand tall and full. Across a long page that plain sans stays clear and approachable.
